text:
nina-peopleops: Quick triage  new hire Leyla K starting 5/3, currently in SF on H-1B transfer. BG vendor flagged name variant (maiden vs current). Also need an authorized agent for I-9 since she'll be remote first week. Thoughts on next steps?

tom-recruiter: She said she can come by SF campus but prefers remote onboarding first week to finish moving. She can do notarized docs or meet an authorized agent.

visa-coordinator: For H-1B transfers we must verify name on passport + I-94. If there's a maiden name on older docs, BG will want supporting affidavit. We can use our authorized agent partner (LocalVerify) to complete the I-9 for remote hires. Cost ~ $60 and they can do same-day visits within Bay Area.

bg-check-bot: BG CHECK UPDATE: Leyla K 1819999200 status: manual review - name variant. Requested supporting docs: passport + marriage certificate or signed affidavit.

nina-peopleops: OK let's plan to: 1) schedule LocalVerify agent for Mon 09:00 at candidate's temporary address, 2) ask Leyla to upload passport + marriage certificate (if applicable) to secure link, 3) hold laptop until ID verified.

newhire-leyla: Hi all 181819999444 I can do the agent visit Mon. I have passport and marriage certificate scanned. Also will need to set up direct deposit and benefits enrollment windows.

it-ops: For shipping policy we'll set "hold until ID verified". If you need device earlier, we can schedule same-day pickup at SF concierge with photo ID. Shipping note: mark pack with SIGNATURE-REQUIRED and "HOLD_IF_NO_ID".

nina-peopleops: Email template I'll send to Leyla: 
```
Subject: Next steps to finish your onboarding (I-9 + BG)
Hi Leyla,
Thanks again and welcome! A few quick items so we can finish background and I-9: 
1) Please upload a photo of your passport and any supporting docs (marriage certificate or legal name change) to https://redwood-secure.upload/newhire
2) We scheduled an authorized agent visit with LocalVerify on Mon 05/03 at 09:00 to complete your I-9 remotely. Please confirm availability.
3) Laptop will be held until ID verification completes; alternative: pick up at SF concierge with photo ID.
4) Payroll will send direct deposit + tax forms (W-4) to your email. International tax items handled by Visa/Payroll.
Thanks! Nina (People Ops)
```

tom-recruiter: I'll confirm logistics with Leyla and share the exact LocalVerify arrival window. Also flag to Hiring Manager that start may be provisional until BG clears.

visa-coordinator: I'll pre-load visa docs to payroll and attach a note on name variants. Payroll will accept certified copy of marriage certificate or notarized affidavit.

bg-check-bot: Docs received 1819999500. Manual reviewer assigned 1819999540.

nina-peopleops: Perfect  once LocalVerify confirms and BG reviewer closes, we release laptop. I'll post final status here. :white_check_mark:
